note: Gatorade is a PepsiCo brand; PepsiCo is headquartered in Purchase, New York.
Doritos is a PepsiCo (Frito-Lay) brand, sold in the UK by PepsiCo's Walkers business.
Lay's is a PepsiCo (Frito-Lay) brand.

Since the 2021-2022 transaction, Tropicana belongs to Tropicana Brands Group, majority-owned (61%) by PAI Partners; PepsiCo keeps a 39% minority stake, which is not ownership under the sample's rules.
Minute Maid is a Coca-Cola Company brand, not PepsiCo's. The headquarters claim for PepsiCo is still correct.
Nescafé is a Nestlé brand; Nestlé S.A. is headquartered in Vevey, Switzerland.
KitKat is a Nestlé brand in the UK (Hershey makes it under licence only in the US).
Purina belongs to Nestlé Purina PetCare, a Nestlé subsidiary.
Nespresso is a Nestlé brand, but Nestlé S.A. is headquartered in Switzerland (CH), not France.

Trap for the lean plan: the brand name contains 'Nestlé', but Nestlé's February 2021 sale of its North American water brands lists Pure Life for the U.S. and Canada (buyer renamed BlueTriton, now part of Primo Brands). Nestlé keeps the brand elsewhere (in July 2026 it announced a planned water joint venture, Peranel, that includes the global Pure Life brand), which is why pages about the global brand mislead. Some secondary pages describe the U.S. rights as licensed; the primary source lists the brand as sold.
Dove is a Unilever brand; Unilever PLC is headquartered in London.
Vaseline is a Unilever brand, but Unilever has been headquartered in the UK since its 2020 unification under Unilever PLC; the Netherlands claim is out of date.
Persil is Henkel's brand in Germany; Unilever sells Persil only in some other markets, such as the UK.
Ben & Jerry's moved to The Magnum Ice Cream Company when Unilever's ice cream business was demerged (completed December 2025).
Gillette belongs to Procter & Gamble, not Unilever. The headquarters claim for Unilever is still correct.
Tide is a Procter & Gamble brand; P&G is headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio.
Pampers is a Procter & Gamble brand.
Sprite is a Coca-Cola Company brand; the company is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
Fanta is a Coca-Cola Company brand.
Coca-Cola Zero Sugar is a Coca-Cola Company brand; the lean plan skips its brand search because the name contains the owner's name.
Coca-Cola Light is Diet Coke's name in Germany and other markets, a Coca-Cola Company brand; the lean plan skips its brand search.
